item.description:
# RunHuddle 0.15.3
- Archived now shows transcript disk usage for the displayed sessions, alongside session and project counts. - Session details show primary transcript file size, allocated disk space, and measurement age for Codex, Claude Code, and Copilot. - Shared transcript files are counted once; unavailable files are reported explicitly. Measurements use file metadata without reading conversation contents.
Storage figures exclude project files, attachments, agent indexes, and saved-work records. APFS blocks may be shared, so allocated space is not necessarily reclaimable space.
Validation: Swift and Python tests, native build, standalone packaging, and updater checks.
